plan.title: eRFX Items drawer rejects negative quantity

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Provide the mandatory event title required for a create test.
Change the default Auction stage to RFQ only.
Choose the first available RFQ template before adding items.
Add the specified product and enter the invalid negative quantity in the Items drawer.
Assert that Procol refuses the invalid quantity and reports an error, corresponding to the red quantity cell.
